hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission bit set, but the afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub. Initial pool tick data is recorded by a separate initializePools() function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-op stubs; the hook does not alter swap behavior.
